mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.role_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM user u JOIN root r ON u.id = r.id AND r.type = 'USER' AND WHERE u.email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE user u JOIN root r ON u.id = r.id AND r.type = 'USER' AND SET u.password = #{hashedPassword}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE u.id = #{userId}
